committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 15 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend fell to $97.11 from $149.57 and clicks to 14 from 19, with CPC at $6.94; the test credit is now fully spent (creditRemainingExGst $0) and campaignStatus shows PAUSED.

With credit at $0, the decision rule applies: review_cta_click sits at 0 since start, so no qualified prospect has booked, meaning the pause stands as written. totalPaidClicks has reached 108, well past the 75-click checkpoint for a red flag review.

Engagement on the question form continues (ask_cta_click 16, quick_question_click 4 since start) but review_cta_click is still 0; the page passed click 25 long ago, so copy stays frozen unless something is broken.

Organic Search sessions rose to 10 from 5 and the branded query 'kontrol ai' shows position 1 with 2 clicks from 3 impressions; aiVisits is still 0 for the week, so no answer-engine signal to report yet. Overall sessions are down to 42 from 49 (-14%), with Saturday 14 at just 1 session versus 8 on the same weekday last week.

actions.text: Credit remaining is now $0, so the pre-agreed decision point is live. Apply the rule as written: keep paid search paused unless cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked, and right now review_cta_click is 0.
Chris should check the test log now: raw totalPaidClicks has hit 108, well past the 75-click threshold. If relevant clicks are 75+ with zero qualified enquiries logged, the red flag fires.

generate_lead shows 2 since the test started. Check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source detail and grade each against the qualified rule (real business, repeatable admin process, named system) in the test log.
The RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success. These need updating to match current site stats.
Logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups are still an open item.
